rule: Summer hunting yields the autumn feather store
texts: When a sky-cat hunts through summer, many feathers accumulate at the cliff base by autumn.
Whenever a sky-cat hunts in summer, the autumn feather store grows.

q2_gaps: durative frame adverbial "through <named period>" ("hunt ... through summer"): the spanning-extent sense has no carrier — During is restricted to during/while/throughout and needs a reified outer eventuality, Start/End needs stated endpoints, and Measure duration needs a count, leaving only the point-like (Time e summer) the parse emitted
review.notes: The bare-plural verbal generic correctly becomes a distributing Skolem-event rule with the frequency adverb "often" set to strength 0.8 / confidence 0.9 and recorded in the mandatory QuantifierPhrase companion, and the volitional intransitive subject takes Agent. Only the "through" extent nuance is lost, per the gap above.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat hunts through summer, many feathers accumulate at the cliff base by autumn.
parse: (: hunt_accumulate_rule (Implication (And (Member $x hunt) (Agent $x $c) (Member $c sky_cat) (Time $x summer)) (And (GroupOf (sk_feathers $x) feather) (CardinalityPhrase (sk_feathers $x) "many") (Member (sk_accumulate $x) accumulate) (Patient (sk_accumulate $x) (sk_feathers $x)) (Location (sk_accumulate $x) sk_base_1) (TimeAtMost (sk_accumulate $x) autumn) (During (sk_accumulate $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: durative 'through <named period>' ('hunts through summer'): no extent carrier exists — `During` is restricted to during/while/throughout over a reified outer eventuality, `Start`/`End` needs from/until wording, and `(Measure e duration n u)` needs a stated count, so only a point-like `(Time $x summer)` is available and the whole-season extent force is dropped
review.notes: 'many feathers' is correctly routed to a per-binding Skolem group with `CardinalityPhrase` rather than to the proportion-strength dial — the rule quantifies over hunt occasions, not over feathers, so a strength of 0.7 plus a QuantifierPhrase would have restated a range appearing nowhere else — and 'by autumn' takes the deadline `TimeAtMost` bound. The 'cliff base' part-whole decomposition, the accumulate event's `Location` (with no LocatedIn on the feathers), and the During tie all match the instruction set.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts in summer, the autumn feather store grows.
parse: (: skycat_hunt_grow_rule (Implication (And (Member $e hunt) (Agent $e $c) (Member $c sky_cat) (Time $e summer)) (And (Member (sk_grow $e) grow) (Theme (sk_grow $e) sk_store_1) (During (sk_grow $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-rule shape, top-level definite witness, per-occurrence Skolem event and During link are all correct, and both compounds emit only the head genus (autumn/feather/sky are noun modifiers, never exposed). Theme for the growing store is the scalar-change-subject route rather than the internal-change Patient route — a boundary call the instruction set resolves in favour of Theme for change-of-value verbs.
